title: 建立Muse Spark 1.1适配器和跨模型基准测试包
description: 构建一个隔离的Meta Model API适配器和可重复的固定基准测试包，用于评估Muse Spark 1.1是否满足正确性、安全性、隐私、延迟、可靠性和治理门控，以决定其是否适合加入模型路由栈。
pain_point: 缺乏系统化的评估框架来验证新模型是否满足所有门控，原文强调“The cheapest correct model wins only after correctness, safety, privacy, latency, reliability, and governance gates are satisfied.” 且“No default-route change is permitted without the completed evidence packet and an explicit operator-approved disposition.” 没有这样的流程，可能导致未经验证的模型被错误路由，带来安全风险和额外成本。
use_case: 在模型路由栈中评估新模型Muse Spark 1.1，通过构建适配器并在MCP可靠性、委托、仓库执行、长上下文完整性、计算机使用安全性和成本调整正确性等六个维度上运行与GPT-5.6、Claude Fable 5等对比模型的固定基准测试，并捕获通过/失败、成本、延迟等指标，最终给出REJECTED、BOUNDED_USE或PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE的处置。

title: Exact HVAC review notes inbox for ChatGPT/Codex readability
description: A system to keep the latest HVAC review notes short enough for ChatGPT/Codex to read full text, preserve exact note text before action, and attach page label, route, URL, viewport, user agent, priority, kind, and visible context. Rotate to fresh inbox if truncation occurs. Quote or summarize exact latest note text and source before acting.
pain_point: The inbox growing too long or starting truncating, causing the exact latest notes to be lost or not fully readable by ChatGPT/Codex, and the need to preserve exact note text and context before agent actions.
use_case: Maintaining a fresh active inbox for exact HVAC review notes that are short enough for ChatGPT/Codex tooling to read the full text, preserving exact note text before any agent acts, and attaching metadata like page label, route, URL, viewport, user agent, priority, kind, and visible context. Rotate to a fresh exact-latest inbox if it grows too long or starts truncating. Before acting, quote or summarize the exact latest note text and the page/route it came from.

title: No first-party PDF viewer for sandbox artifacts
description: The agent needed to visually confirm a generated PDF report before completing the task, but there is no platform command to view a PDF artifact. It had to hand-roll a workflow: invoke a second sandbox to rasterize the PDF to PNGs using pdftoppm, then Read each PNG. This process had to be repeated after a chart fix, wasting time and sandbox calls. Every sandbox-generated document (PDF, docx, etc.) will encounter the same limitation.
pain_point: No first-party way to look at a generated PDF; agent must manually rasterize using pdftoppm and Read each PNG, repeating the cycle after fixes, and every sandbox-generated document artifact will hit the same wall.
use_case: Agent generates a PDF report from CSV data via `gipity sandbox run` and needs to visually confirm the layout before calling the task done.

title: Deterministic game loop stepping for headless verification
description: The platform's headless browser cannot run render loops at speed, making real-time verification of canvas/physics games impossible. The platform warns about false negatives due to wall-clock waiting and suggests stepping the loop deterministically, but provides no such tool. As a result, agents cannot verify core game mechanics like brick collisions, scoring, and win/lose transitions.
pain_point: The platform's headless browser can't run the render loop at speed; waiting on real wall-clock time advances the physics far slower than it appears, causing false negatives; nothing in the CLI or the skills gives the agent a way to step a running game loop, so the verify step is the only step with no working tool.
use_case: Agent built a Phaser brick-breaker game and attempted to verify the real gameplay loop (ball bounces, bricks break, score increments, lives decrement) by driving the deployed page with `gipity page eval`. On the third eval that would confirm a brick collision and a score change, the platform returned a warning that the page painted at 14.5 fps, that waiting on real wall-clock time advances the physics far slower than it appears, that assertions after a wall-clock wait can report a false negative, and that the agent should instead 'step the app's own loop deterministically'. The agent had no follow-up move: it dropped real-time verification entirely, took a static screenshot, and shipped the game with its core mechanic (brick collision -> score -> win/lose transitions) never exercised.

pain_point: 현재 hook이 저장하는 raw args는 필요 이상의 개인정보(prompt, args, user, repo 등)를 남기며, hook이 꺼진 host와 진짜 호출 0회를 구분할 health 신호도 제공하지 않아 불필요한 데이터 노출과 모니터링 공백이 발생함.
use_case: log-skill.sh에서 args, user, repo 등 raw payload를 수집 중이며, 보고서는 timestamp와 skill name만 사용함. 수집 계약을 최소화하고 privacy-safe한 v2 JSONL schema로 전환하여 skill_invocation 이벤트만 기록하고자 함. 기존 legacy TSV와 새 v2 JSONL을 혼용하며, 기존 로그는 건드리지 않음.

title: Convert Direct Codex native lifecycle to capability-based slot contract
description: Current documentation assumes a fixed lifecycle (spawn_agent → wait_agent → close_agent) with 6 threads, but the live developer surface lacks explicit close and advertises only 4 active slots including root. The proposal replaces fixed contracts with capability profiles that select current/legacy/unknown based on actual tool availability and advertised slots, adding a CLI-default probe and active-session gate to avoid false safety.
pain_point: Documentation assumes explicit close and fixed 6 slots, but live surface has no close_agent and only 4 active slots including root, causing document-conformant execution to fail when calling missing close or spawning excessive reviewers.
use_case: Aligning Direct Codex documentation and runtime mapping with the actual codex-cli 0.144.1 developer surface to prevent execution failures when calling non-existing close_agent or spawning more reviewers than available slots.

title: replace boolean tool outcomes with native error semantics
description: Refactor the Khala runtime tools to replace the existing KhalaToolResult envelope with an explicit success-or-coded-error result contract, removing the 'ok' boolean and using stable error codes like 'invalid_issue_packet'.
pain_point: The current behavior duplicates success state, treats validation failure as success, and adds visual burden. For example, a normal validation renders as '{ ok: true, summary: "...", data: { valid: true, missing: [] } }', which hides the failure in the data field.
use_case: In the Khala runtime, the six runtime tools share a public 'KhalaToolResult' envelope discriminated by 'ok', and 'khala_triage.validate' reports both conforming and nonconforming packets as successful tool executions, with the latter only distinguishable through 'data.valid: false'. The goal is to use an explicit success-or-coded-error result contract without an 'ok' boolean, where success contains { summary, data? }, failure contains { summary, error }, and callers narrow with the error field.

The agent needs to run commands like `Neo.get('my-component-id')` inside a dedicated worker to inspect live objects that exist only within the worker.

title: Fix gh shim recursive selection of another aidevops shim after hot deploy
description: The aidevops `gh` shim can recursively select a different aidevops `gh` shim as its downstream executable when a long-running session has an immutable runtime-bundle shim and a mutable installed shim both ahead of native GitHub CLI on `PATH`. Each shim excludes only its own directory in `_find_real_gh()`, so the runtime-bundle shim selects the installed shim and vice versa, causing `gh --version` to alternate until timeout. This blocks issue reads, claims, PR operations, diagnostics, pulse routines, and any framework helper that invokes `gh`. Even the documented bypass `AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1` fails because it uses the same defective resolver.
pain_point: The shim recursively selects another aidevops shim instead of native GitHub CLI, causing `gh` commands to hang indefinitely until external timeout kills the chain. This blocks all GitHub CLI operations (version, auth, issue, PR, etc.) and initially resembles rate limiting, but connectivity and quota are healthy. The documented bypass `AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1` also recurses, leaving no simple workaround. The user must either manually sanitize `PATH` or invoke `/usr/bin/gh` directly, breaking automation and framework helpers that rely on plain `gh`.
use_case: The user runs a long-running session (e.g., OpenCode interactive session) with an immutable runtime-bundle `agents/scripts` directory and a mutable installed `agents/scripts` directory both on `PATH` before native GitHub CLI. They execute `gh --version`, `gh auth status`, or any GitHub operation. The expected result is a prompt invocation of native GitHub CLI, but instead the command times out due to recursive shim selection.

title: Multi-Agent Coordination Health Monitor with Deadlock Detection
description: Build a real-time monitor that tracks agent task completion, detects deadlocks (circular blocking, all agents idle with pending work), identifies bottleneck agents (consistently slow vs peers), and triggers auto-recovery (task reassignment, agent restart, escalation to PM), reducing coordination-related failures by 40%+.

No existing monitor detects stuck agents, identifies bottlenecks, or provides auto-recovery, leading to wasted time and reduced success rate. Lack of event logging and dashboard integration hinders root cause analysis.

User needs a real-time monitor tracking heartbeat and task progress for all active agents, detecting deadlock conditions, identifying bottleneck agents, auto-triggering recovery (reassign tasks from stuck agents, restart hung agents, escalate to PM), logging coordination events, and integrating dashboard showing real-time agent health in team view.

title: Fix SYSTEM_PROMPT tool name mismatch: query_multimodal_ai vs query_multimodal_api
description: The SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs the model to call 'query_multimodal_ai', but the MCP tool is registered as 'query_multimodal_api'. This causes tool call failures ('unknown tool'), requiring extra correction iterations per turn or failed vision analysis on models that don't retry.
pain_point: The prompt text names a tool ('query_multimodal_ai') that does not exist in the tool list handed to the model, causing every camera-snapshot-related tool call to fail with 'unknown tool' and requiring extra correction iterations or complete failure on models that don't retry.

The model follows the prompt and emits a tool call named query_multimodal_ai, which fails, costing an extra correction iteration per turn or a failed vision analysis on smaller local models that trust prompt text over the tool schema list.

description: 用户希望通过机器学习方法自动判断两个HTML表格是否描述相同概念，替代当前手动比较行标签集合的低效方法。用户需要简单易懂的入门资源，特别是能直接应用于具体任务的示例代码，并希望了解如何将示例表格和候选表格输入AI模型以及如何指定特征属性。

use_case: 用户想构建一个系统，输入已知类型的示例表格和一张新HTML表格，自动判断新表是否属于已识别的类型。当前使用暴力方法：提取所有行标签，与已知类型表的行标签集合比较交集大小来判定。用户希望用更优雅的AI方法，但不知如何开始，需要看到别人使用类似工具的代码示例来学习。

title: Extract camera motion keyframes from video for AI animation
description: User needs a Python tool, library, or Colab notebook to extract camera motion keyframes (e.g., from a drone video) and export them for use in AI art animation and to incorporate into their own AI tools notebook.
pain_point: The only example found is in Blender; no script, library, or notebook exists for this specific extraction; user does not know where to start given their intermediate Python skills.
use_case: Input a drone video, extract camera keyframe movements, export to a file for use in AI Art Animation, and integrate the solution into a Colab notebook of AI tools built over months.

title: Check deviations for "Created using AI tools" disclaimer via DeviantArt API
description: User needs to find an API endpoint that returns whether a deviation has the 'created using AI tools' disclaimer, as the current metadata retrieval does not include this information.
pain_point: The DeviantArt API response does not include the 'created using AI tools' disclaimer, even after retrieving extended metadata.
use_case: Writing Python code to authorize and retrieve a deviation's extended metadata via DeviantArt API, expecting the AI notice disclaimer in the response, but it is missing.

title: Kaggle中技能与AI token消费的相对重要性
description: 用户想知道在Kaggle竞赛中，实际技能是否仍然重要，还是成功主要取决于花费更多AI token来自动化常规任务。
pain_point: 不确定是否值得投入时间学习技能，因为成功可能依赖AI token消费，而非个人能力。
use_case: 用户想进入Kaggle，但担心AI工具会削弱技能的价值，需要明确技能与自动化工具开销在竞赛成功中的权重。

title: Safe AI integration into production workflows with validation
description: Users need best practices for integrating AI tools (especially LLMs) into production workflows without over-relying on them, ensuring quality and reliability through validation layers, human-in-the-loop patterns, and balancing productivity with oversight.
pain_point: AI often produces confident but subtly incorrect outputs; introduces edge-case bugs in generated code; team members may accept responses without fully reviewing them, risking long-term technical debt instead of leverage.
use_case: Integrating AI tools (LLMs) for content drafting, code suggestions, and internal automation in a real-world development team, seeking to maintain quality and reliability while boosting productivity.

title: CREW AI tool not using ChatGroq
description: 用户已经按照CREW AI文档在tools.py和agents.py中配置了ChatGroq，但运行时出现错误，需要解决方法。
pain_point: 用户已按文档尝试配置但运行错误，且不清楚如何正确使用ChatGroq，导致工具无法正常工作。
use_case: 用户正在使用CREW AI框架开发工具，需要在agents.py中集成ChatGroq作为LLM，但按照文档配置后运行出错。

title: Search methodology to avoid relying on AI tools for coding solutions
description: User fears that relying on AI tools for coding problems is killing their problem-solving, thinking, focus, and understanding skills. They seek a repeatable methodology to search for and find solutions on their own before turning to AI.
pain_point: Immediately turning to AI tools replaces the brain's thinking process, causing a cancerous degradation of problem-solving skills, thinking skills, focus, and understanding.
use_case: When facing a technical issue while writing code that is difficult to solve and the user doesn't know how to search for it, they want a methodology to search and find the solution before resorting to AI tools.

title: Generate PPT slides from selected rows of Excel sheet using free AI tools
description: 用户希望利用免费AI工具，从Excel表格中选取最多300行数据，每行生成一张PPT幻灯片。用户提供了示例Excel表格（2行）和一张手动制作的幻灯片作为参考。
pain_point: 手动为每行创建PPT幻灯片耗时费力，尤其是当行数多达300行时；用户希望使用免费工具实现自动化，但缺乏现成的免费AI工具直接支持该功能。
use_case: 用户有一个包含多个字段的Excel表格，需要为选定的多行（每行对应一张幻灯片）自动生成PPT，每张幻灯片展示该行的数据。用户提供了示例Excel表格（仅两行）和一张手动制作的幻灯片作为输出样式参考。

title: AI SDK: Prevent LLM from Duplicating Tool Output in Markdown
description: When using AI SDK streamText(), the LLM returns a Text Result that includes a Markdown-formatted version of the tool output, duplicating the structured Tool Result already rendered as a UI component. The user wants the LLM to generate only a short summary or context instead of repeating the full tool output.
pain_point: The LLM repeatedly outputs the full tool result in Markdown even though the data is already rendered as a component, and adjusting the system prompt to ask for a short summary does not work.
use_case: Using AI SDK streamText() with tool calls, where the tool result is displayed as a dedicated UI component, but the LLM's text response also contains the full tool output in Markdown format. The user wants the LLM to only provide a brief textual summary referencing the tool result, without duplicating the data.

title: spring-ai tools无法与OpenRouter Gemini模型配合使用
description: 用户在spring-ai中使用OpenRouter统一API调用Gemini模型时，tools和MCP集成无法正常工作，模型下工具调用返回null，而模型正常工作。用户需要配置spring-ai以支持其他模型（如Gemini）的工具调用。
pain_point: spring-ai默认只支持模型进行工具调用，导致Gemini模型工具调用返回null，警告提示无法使用，用户无法在不切换模型的情况下正常使用MCP工具功能。
use_case: 在spring-ai中通过OpenRouter调用Gemini模型，并集成Filesystem MCP Server作为工具，期望模型能像一样调用工具获取文件系统信息。

title: AI tool to generate test cases from English and convert to executable code with debugging support
description: User needs an AI-based tool to write test cases in plain English, convert them to executable test code (JavaScript, Java, Python), help debug failures, suggest fixes, and assist in maintaining/refactoring test code when application changes. Prefers free/open-source.
pain_point: Currently lacks an AI tool that can automatically convert natural language test cases into executable code and help with debugging and refactoring, possibly requiring manual effort or heavy enterprise tools.
use_case: Writing test cases in plain English and converting them into executable test code in languages like JavaScript, Java, Python, with debugging support and maintenance/refactoring assistance.

title: Monorepo与AI工具结合是否提供真正的实际优势
description: 用户想知道在monorepo中使用AI编码工具（Copilot, Cursor）是否比multi-repo有实际优势，特别是对于TypeScript代码库和共享域逻辑。用户假设monorepo能提供完整代码上下文以改善AI建议质量，但需要验证。
pain_point: 多仓库下共享功能要么重复要么部分复用，导致不一致和bug在不同项目间修复不同步；缺少完整上下文使得AI工具的建议质量存疑，用户无法确定是否值得迁移。
use_case: 用户正在评估将前端多应用和共享库从多仓库迁移到monorepo（如Nx/Turborepo），并希望了解AI辅助开发在monorepo中能否利用完整代码上下文提供更好的重构建议、跨应用变更传播和类型一致性。

title: Error using Azure AI search performance testing tool with Terraform

pain_point: Pipeline fails with 'file is missing' error because the test artifacts are not downloaded successfully, likely due to user's inexperience with Terraform and inability to apply the suggested solution from related discussions.
use_case: Performance testing for an AI search tool using Azure AI search performance testing tool, specifically running the load-test.yml pipeline from the git repo to download test artifacts and convert to output.xml.

title: Fix mksdcard SDK tool error during Android Studio installation on Ubuntu
description: User repeatedly encounters 'Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool' error in the setup wizard while installing Android Studio on Ubuntu, and also sees related errors in terminal. Need a solution to resolve this issue to complete installation.
pain_point: Getting 'Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool' error repeatedly in the setup wizard and also in the terminal, blocking the installation process.
use_case: Installing Android Studio on Ubuntu, specifically during the setup wizard step where mksdcard SDK tool is required.

title: Handle follow-up confirmations in Spring AI tool calling with RAG without losing context
description: 用户使用Spring Boot 3.4.5和Spring AI 1.0.0集成Llama3.2，通过RAG动态过滤工具进行工具调用。但在后续确认步骤中，用户输入短通用确认（如'yes'、'confirm'）时，RAG系统因缺乏上下文无法选择正确工具，导致工具选择失败。用户希望找到最佳实践来管理后续确认，而不重新触发工具过滤并丢失原始意图上下文。
pain_point: 当用户回复短通用确认（如'yes'、'confirm'、'go ahead'）时，RAG系统因缺乏上下文无法选择正确工具，工具选择逻辑失效；后续多个澄清问题（如'change the name'、'what email did I give?'）使状态管理和意图保留复杂化，单个工具难以优雅处理所有后续查询。
use_case: 使用Spring Boot 3.4.5和Spring AI 1.0.0集成Llama3.2(Ollama)模型，实现工具调用，通过RAG（基于工具描述和元数据的语义搜索）过滤并传递相关工具给LLM执行。用户希望在工具调用流程中实现后续确认步骤（如用户回复'yes'、'confirm'、'go ahead'），但当前当用户给出短通用确认时，RAG系统无法正确选择工具。用户也提及后续澄清问题（如'change the name'、'what email did I give?'）的管理困难——单个工具需优雅处理所有后续查询。

title: Azure AI Foundry Agent fails to pass runtime input variables to OpenAPI tool
description: When using Azure AI Foundry to create an Agent that calls an OpenAPI tool, runtime input variables (such as a bearer token) are not passed correctly from agent input to the tool. This results in empty/incorrect values or validation errors (e.g., missing headers, bad request). The user has tried various prompt styles without success and seeks a way to ensure variables are passed, either via configuration or proper prompting.
pain_point: Runtime input variables (e.g., bearer token) are not passed from agent input to the OpenAPI tool, causing tool invocation to fail with missing headers or bad request errors. The user is unable to find a reliable way to pass these variables despite trying various prompt styles.
use_case: Creating an Azure AI Foundry Agent that calls an OpenAPI tool requiring runtime inputs (e.g., a bearer token in the header). The user passes the token as an input to the Agent and expects it to be used in the tool invocation, but the tool receives empty or incorrect values.

title: Post-hoc explainable AI method for complex CNN architectures like Mask R-CNN
description: Users are seeking an easily applicable post-hoc explainable AI tool specifically for object detection tasks performed by complex CNN-based architectures, such as Mask R-CNN.
pain_point: No readily available or easily applicable post-hoc explainability method for detection outputs of complex CNN architectures.
use_case: Explaining detection results from complex CNN-based models like Mask R-CNN using a post-hoc approach.

title: Implement tool disable functionality in Spring AI MCP Client
description: The user wants to build a REST API to list active and deactivate MCP servers or specific tools, similar to Cloud Desktop's ability to disable entire modules or specific tools, but lacks understanding of how MCP Client works within Spring AI and seeks implementation suggestions.

They propose creating a REST API where users can list active and deactivate tools, but they do not understand how the MCP Client part works within Spring.

title: Security Context Propagation in Spring AI MCP Server Tool Invocation

pain_point: SecurityContext在工具执行线程中无效，尝试了多种方法（如publisher、线程池配置、自定义provider）均未解决问题，且部分尝试（如自定义provider）导致工具列表获取失败。
use_case: 通过Spring Boot客户端发送带bearer token的请求调用MCP Server工具，服务器将工具执行委托给boundedElastic线程，但SecurityContext未传播导致错误。

title: Spring AI MCP tools not returning response via SSE
description: User has set up Spring Boot with Spring AI MCP server and defined @Tool methods, but when calling tools via SSE from a Python client, the server receives the request but never sends back a response, causing client timeout. User seeks guidance on why responses are not returned and how to debug.
pain_point: When invoking tools/list or custom tools like getJob via SSE, the Spring Boot MCP server receives the request (confirmed by log: 'Mapped to WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider') but fails to send a response back to the SSE queue. The Python client times out waiting for a response. This prevents remote tool invocation from working, blocking the integration between Spring Boot MCP server and external clients.
use_case: User is building a Spring Boot application with Spring AI MCP server enabled (spring.ai.mcp.server.enabled=true) and defines tools as Spring @Service methods annotated with @Tool. A Python client connects via SSE at /management/mcp/message, establishes session, sends JSON-RPC requests like tools/list or custom tool calls (e.g., getJob). Expected: server processes tool call and sends response back to SSE client. Actual: server logs show request received but no response sent back; Python client times out.

title: Production-ready tool-calling loop and state persistence architecture

pain_point: Lack of production-ready examples or architecture for safely managing the multi-step tool-calling loop, and unclear recommended approach for handling state persistence, conversation history, and agent memory across multiple user sessions.
use_case: Building an autonomous AI Agent in a modern .NET application using Microsoft.Agents.AI and Microsoft.Extensions.AI packages, giving the agent access to custom native C# tools (database queries, internal APIs) to autonomously decide when to execute functions based on user intent.
